policy_chunks.title: Leave Policy
policy_chunks.content: Employees receive 20 days of annual leave per year. Planned leave should be requested at least three working days in advance and requires manager approval. Employees should notify their manager as soon as possible when taking sick leave.

policy_chunks.title: Working Hours Policy
policy_chunks.content: Standard working hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, with a one-hour lunch break. Employees should coordinate changes to their schedule with their manager and attend agreed team meetings.

policy_chunks.title: Remote Work Policy
policy_chunks.content: Eligible employees may work remotely up to two days per week with manager approval. Remote employees must remain available during agreed working hours, use approved company systems, and protect confidential information.

policy_chunks.title: Expense Reimbursement Policy
policy_chunks.content: Reasonable business expenses require manager approval. Employees must submit an expense claim with itemized receipts within 30 days of the expense. Approved claims are reimbursed in the next monthly payment cycle.
